mandatoryPackagingElements.name: FSSAI Green Vegetarian Dot Emblem
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Green square border with filled green circle inside, minimum 6 mm size on PDP near product name.

mandatoryPackagingElements.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP incl. of all taxes)
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Mandatory declaration 'MRP ₹... (inclusive of all taxes)' in bold clear print.

mandatoryPackagingElements.name: Unit Sale Price (USP)
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Mandatory unit sale price expressed per gram or per 100g contiguous to MRP.

mandatoryPackagingElements.name: 14-Digit FSSAI License Number & Logo
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Standard FSSAI wordmark logo alongside 14-digit state/central license number.

mandatoryPackagingElements.name: Consumer Care / Grievance Redressal Contact
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Contact person name, complete address, toll-free phone number, and email for consumer grievances.

mandatoryPackagingElements.name: Metric Net Quantity Declaration (Grams / Kilograms)
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Net weight declared in metric grams/kg only. US customary ounces are removed from primary declaration.

mandatoryPackagingElements.name: Date of Packaging & Best Before Duration
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Date of manufacture/packaging and 'Best Before' statement.

mandatoryPackagingElements.name: Country of Origin Declaration
mandatoryPackagingElements.description: Country of origin declaration for imported goods (e.g. 'Country of Origin: USA').
